plain: Components now animate on press, open, close and selection, and bare transition-* utilities time on the productive motion token (150ms) instead of Tailwind's default; re-take screenshots after interactions, and wait for overlay animations to finish in visual tests.

steps.plain: A bare transition-* utility now lasts the productive motion token (150ms, 0 under reduced motion) instead of a fixed .15s; set your own duration-* class if you need a fixed time.
A bare transition-* utility now eases on the productive motion token's curve instead of Tailwind's default curve; set your own ease-* class if you need the old curve.
